items.title: A resolution computes the cohomology of the product total complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an exact resolution of a complex of abelian groups the product total complex of the associated double complex maps by a quasi-isomorphism onto the resolved complex (statement lines 7233-7244). The proof is a complete argument: the author recalls the definition of the product total complex together with its differential (proof lines 7247-7252), and then proves that the comparison map is a quasi-isomorphism degree by degree, using the exactness of the resolution to represent cocycles by elements of the first column and to compare the resulting coboundaries (proof lines 7253-7280). The non-formal content is the degreewise comparison of cocycles and coboundaries. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
